title: Print the list after modifying one company
description:
Print the list after modifying one of the companies.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as modify_company(companies, index, new_name), returning a new list equal to companies but with the item at index replaced by new_name.
hints: Make a copy of the list first so the original companies list you were given isn't mutated.
List items can be replaced in place with index assignment, e.g. lst[i] = value.
Copy companies, set updated[index] = new_name, and return updated.
expected_behavior: Returns a new list with the item at the given index replaced by new_name.
solution:
def modify_company(companies, index, new_name):
    updated = companies.copy()
    updated[index] = new_name
    return updated
explanation: Copying the list keeps the caller's original list intact, and index assignment replaces exactly the item at the requested position.
